subject: Signal and System
questionText:
A signal containing only two frequency components
(3 kHz and 6 kHz) is sampled at the rate of 8 kHz,
and then passed through a low pass filter with a cut-
off frequency of 8 kHz. The filter output
(a)
is an undistorted version of the original signal.
(b) contains only the 3 kHz component.
(c)
contains the 3 kHz component and a spurious
component of 2 kHz."
(d) contains both the components of the original
signal and two spurious components of 2 kHz
and 5 kHz.
